title: Investigate
lede: How /investigate finds the root cause of a bug before changing any code, then proves the fix with fresh evidence.

repro.name: Reproduce
repro.role: Read the whole error, reproduce it on demand, and trace back to where it first goes wrong.
details: Until this step is done, only logging and probes are allowed, not behavior changes.

more: Read the full trace, warnings and exit codes.
Write down the exact steps that reproduce it.
Check what changed: git log, diff, environment.
Log what crosses each boundary and trace back to the divergence.

compare.name: Compare
compare.role: Find similar code that works and list every difference.
details: Include differences that seem like they can't matter.
Note what the broken path assumes: config, env vars, ordering, file layout.

hypothesis.name: Hypothesis
hypothesis.role: Write down one guess about the cause and test it with the smallest change.
details: Form: X is the root cause because Y.
Change one variable at a time.
risks: Stacking a second change on an unconfirmed first one hides which change mattered.

fix.name: Fix
fix.role: Write a failing regression test, then make one fix at the root cause.
details: The test must fail for the named reason, not a bad fixture or import.
No bundled refactors or unrelated edits.

verify.name: Verify
verify.role: Re-run the new test, the original command and nearby tests, then report.
details: Never say fixed or passing without output produced in this turn.
Not fixed, and under three tries: go back to Reproduce with the new information.

more: Symptom, root cause, evidence, fix, regression test, commands re-run.

risks: After three failed fixes, stop and question the design with the user before a fourth.
qs: Why stop after three failed fixes instead of trying a fourth?

root.d: The first place behavior diverges from intent.

regression.d: An automated test that catches the bug if it comes back.

fresh.d: Output produced this turn, not an earlier run.

ask.context: The reader wants to understand how scaffold's /investigate skill debugs a failure before fixing it.
